interpretation: One bounded recorded-input GPU run confirms that the client can pace 160 ms audio chunks while MiniCPM-o 4.5 processes video and emits speech during continued input. It does not verify the model's internal 160 ms scheduling, human interruption, live microphone interaction, human-perceived latency, or Higgs Realtime Duplex.
